test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ustad Asad Ali Khan is famous for which of the following schools of Dhrupad as an instrumentalist?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **Khandarbani.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ustad Asad Ali Khan **was a Rudra Veena player with expertise in **Khandar school of Drupad.**
 
• Hindustani classical music from the Indian subcontinent includes the genre of dhrupad.
 
• It is the earliest known form of the main vocal genres connected to Haveli Sangeet of Pushtimarg Sampraday,
 
• Hindustani classical music, and the South Indian Carnatic tradition.
 
• Sthayi (or Asthayi), Antara, Sanchari, and Abhoga are the four stanzas that make up a Dhrupad.
 
• The history of Dhrupad may be traced back to Braj (Mathura) saints like as Swami Haridas, Surdas, Govind Swami, Asht Sakha of Haveli Sangeet, Tansen, and Baiju Bawara.
 
• Vishnupad is the term used when a Dhrupad composition is based on Bhagwan Shri Vishnu or one of his incarnations.
